programme.title: The Crusades
programme.desc: Three friends set out for one last great weekend while dodging authority, love affairs, and violent foes.

programme.title: Miss Congeniality

programme.title: NHL Hockey

programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.desc: The Jets try to even their Western Conference semifinal with the Stars in Game 4 from Texas. Mikko Rantanen continued his spectacular postseason with a goal and two assists as Dallas took a 5-2 victory and a 2-1 series advantage in Game 3.

programme.title: NHL Hockey

programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.desc: The Stars try a second time to ground the Jets in Game 6 of their Western Conference semifinal. Connor Hellebuyck turned away all 22 Dallas shots in Game 5 and Nikolaj Ehlers scored twice to power Winnipeg to a 4-0 victory to stave off elimination.

programme.title: Sesame Street S54
programme.desc: Elmo, Tamir, Charlie, Julia, and Cookie Monster are making self-portraits in the community garden with Kayla. Kayla guides them to look into the mirror and notice the beautiful things that make you, you! Everyone looks at themselves in the mirror and starts drawing what they see. They also learn their identity is about what you love to do. So, they add onto their self-portraits and then share their drawings with each other. Cookie Monster draws his blue fur, his googly eyes, and cookies. Charlie draws her blue eyes, curly blonde hair, tap shoes, and challah bread because it’s one of her favorite Jewish foods. Julia draws her straight hair, musical notes, paw prints, and her dog Rose. Elmo draws his red fur, orange nose, a piano, and watering a flower with Abby because being a kind neighbor is part of Elmo’s identity. Tamir draws his brown skin, coily hair, comic books, and some veggies as he loves gardening in the community garden. There are so many special things that make you, you!

programme.desc: A highly respected businessman and a wise-cracking street bum are forced to trade places as part of a degenerate bet between two monarchs of Wall Street.

programme.title: Stomp The Yard
programme.desc: After the death of his brother, an expert street dancer goes to Georgia to attend Truth University. But his efforts to get an education and woo the girl he likes are sidelined when he joins in his fraternity's effort to win a step dancing competition.

programme.title: Dune
programme.desc: This is the saga of Intergalactic warrior Paul Atreides and his messianic rise to lead his people and their struggle for survival. The young hero leads his warriors against an evil baron and tries to destroy a galaxy-wide trade in 'spice.'.

programme.title: Kickboxer

programme.title: Jumper

programme.title: Wala Ka Nang Lupang Tatapakan
programme.desc: A soldier whose dedication to duty is unwavering, Daniel finds himself going against authority when his wife and son were murdered. With the local police unwilling to go after the perpetrator of the crime, Daniel decides to take matters into his own hands.

programme.title: Hindi Tayo Pwede
programme.desc: Gabby (Lovi Poe) finds love in a man who is also named Gabby (Tony Labrusca) and shares a long and deep friendship with Dennis (Marco Gumabao).

programme.title: Ang Manananggal na Nahahati ang Puso
programme.desc: A barrio lass agrees to be the subject of a man's research about aswangs. He falls for her but hides his feelings knowing that she's an aswang.

programme.title: Panabla
programme.desc: Panabla.

programme.title: Mang Jose
programme.desc: Having the ability of energy absorption and redirection, Mang Jose covertly saves people only if they rent him out. One day, Tope rents Mang Jose to help him save his mother who has been abducted by mysterious troopers of King Ina.

programme.title: Baliktaran
programme.desc: A hilarious comedy about a couple switching roles to make their marriage work.

programme.title: Walang Kapalit
programme.desc: A marriage gone sour with the husband leaving the wife, taking along a minor daughter and lying to her about her mother. Meanwhile, each carries a relationship with other parties. Deciding to forego their annulment case, they commit to give their marriage a second try.

programme.title: Momzillas
programme.desc: Clara and Minerva, the two women who shared the same man, meet again when their son and daughter, respectively, are about to marry each other.

programme.title: Sundo
programme.desc: Romano sees ghosts. But he sees ghost only around people who will soon encounter sudden, tragic deaths. Romano, Louella, and Isabel now face the biggest fight of their lives.

programme.title: Mauban: Ang Resiko
programme.desc: A family in Cagbalete Island ekes out their living through wine-making, fishing and charcoal-making. A daily fare, resiko treat has become a threat to the family's fight for survival.

programme.title: Shoot! Shoot! Di Ko Siya Titigilan!
programme.desc: When an aspiring actor practices his role as a billionaire out loud, gossip about him being rich spreads like wildfire. Now, the girls and the goons are after him.

programme.title: Pusong Mamon
programme.desc: A funny heart warming story about three extraordinary people and their equally extraordinary relationship.

programme.title: Yorme: The Isko Domagoso Story
programme.desc: Isko Moreno, a once lowly garbage collector who became an actor and now a government servant who dreams for a better life for every Filipino.

programme.title: Alas-Dose
programme.desc: A mad bomber is on the loose and the bomb squad leader Col. Titus Varona (Cesar Montano) is at his wits' end.

programme.title: Miracle in Cell No. 7
programme.desc: Joselito (Aga Muhlach), an intellectually-disabled man, is wrongfully charged assault and murder. In prison he becomes friends with his fellow inmates and together they form a plan to see his young daughter (Xia Vigor) inside the cell. Years after, his daughter (Bela Padilla) becomes a lawyer and is determined to prove her father's innocence.

programme.title: Sid \u0026 Aya (Not A Love Story)
programme.desc: It follows Sid (Dingdong Dantes) who suffers from insomnia and meets Aya (Anne Curtis) who he hires to accompany him in his sleepless nights.

programme.title: Bekikang
programme.desc: Bekikang is left and abandoned with a baby boy by friend, Fortunato. He loves and raises the child as his own flesh and blood.

programme.title: Tatarin
programme.desc: An adaptation of the popular play of Nick Joaquin,Tatarin tackles the celebration of a sacred feast that liberates.

programme.title: Ang Babaeng Walang Pakiramdam
programme.desc: A woman diagnosed with a rare congenital disease that makes her incapable of feeling physical and emotional pain meets a man with cleft palate who makes her feel love like she never has before.

programme.title: Anong Ganap?
programme.desc: Being in on the entertainment circle is quick and easy on PBO's Anong Ganap? Presented by the gorgeous entertainment anchor ng bayan, Phoemela Baranda.

programme.title: Manila's Finest
programme.desc: Manila's Finest is inspired and based on the life and career of retired Western Police District (WPD) Col. Jimmy Tiu, who last served as the Sta. Mesa police station commander of WPD.

programme.title: Obsesyon
programme.desc: Screen nymphet Rita Magdalena stars as the object of man’s obsession in this daring movie about a love that knows no bounds and recognizes no rules.

programme.title: Room 213
programme.desc: The story follows the endangered relationship of an architect and his wife, a photographer. After being married for 10 years, they have lost all emotional connections with each other.

programme.title: Steal
programme.desc: When money is involved, trust is a big word. Four Filipinas based in Japan will learn the hard truth about money and trust as they get entangled in their own schemes.

programme.title: Apat Dapat, Dapat Apat
programme.desc: Four women who swear to be friends forever, become domestic helpers when they go over to another country.

programme.title: Bakit Lahat ng Gwapo May Boyfriend?
programme.desc: Kylie (Anne Curtis), a wedding planner has had a long string of boyfriends. Unfortunately for her, they've all been gay.

programme.title: Anong Ganap?
programme.desc: Being in on the entertainment circle is quick and easy on PBO's Anong Ganap? Presented by the gorgeous entertainment anchor ng bayan, Phoemela Baranda.

programme.title: Revirginized
programme.desc: Carmela (Sharon Cuneta) gets to enjoy life again in a wild beach party. With young people and a hunk tattoo artist, she drowns herself in alcohol to forget her current self and renew her old self.

programme.title: Pilak
programme.desc: Pilak.

programme.title: Ikaw Pa Rin Ang Pipiliin Ko
programme.desc: Music gives her life. Music is his life. This is a story that will make our hearts skip a beat this season of love.

programme.title: Hating Kapatid
programme.desc: Hating Kapatid is a movie that teaches us how siblings should stick together in times of happiness and problems.

programme.title: Diary ng Panget
programme.desc: Eya (Nadine Lustre) and Cross (James Reid) didn't get along at first, their relationship becomes complicated but soon, they fall in love with each other.

programme.title: Wangbu
programme.desc: Dodong (Jay Manalo) moves his family to Manila in search for a better life. But his dream for a brighter future starts crumbling when he catches his son sniffing solvent.

programme.title: Pedro Penduko Episode 2 (The Return of the Comeback)
programme.desc: He is descendant of a Legendary hero, but for the young Pedro Penduko (Janno Gibbs) heroism in the silver screen is more appealing than real life bravado. But Pedro is not destined to be a movie star, he finds himself in the center of a kingdom in need of a hero.

programme.title: Darkroom
programme.desc: A group of teenage friends who seeks the thrill of ghost-hunting, and stumbles upon an old camera. As they carelessly play with it, they unknowingly summon the demon that exists inside.

programme.title: Lupe, A Seaman's Wife
programme.desc: Lupe (Andrea del Rosario) and Manolo (Leandro Muñoz ) are a young couple whose marriage life is about to undergo a drastic change when Manolo leaves for another country.

programme.title: Ikaw Lamang
programme.desc: A charming, light-hearted tale about the ups and downs of growing up, and the joys and pains of young love.

programme.title: Isang Lahi, Isang Dugo Sa Lupang Pangako
programme.desc: \"Lupang Pangako\" or Land of Promise --- that is what people call Mindanao because of its vast untapped natural resources. As such, several people want to claim it for themselves.

programme.title: Buhay Kamao
programme.desc: Pepe, did not want anything to do with boxing but the easy money involved in the sport attracted him when he was desperate to pay off a long standing debt. Little did he know that the match was just the beginning of a series of tests.

programme.title: Hello, Universe!
programme.desc: Ariel (Janno Gibbs), a middle-aged man full of regrets, gets another chance to rewrite his past when he meets a magical figure who gives him the life he has always dreamt of. But at what cost?

programme.title: Bullet
programme.desc: He has the mind and temper of a young child, but when it comes to guns, Bullet (Cesar) is as adept as a highly trained marksman. But this very special talent comes into a harrowing play when Bullet.
Anton and Erika have been a couple for 12 years already. While he's not yet ready to get married, Erika waits until he is and lovingly devotes her time to him.

programme.title: Ang Erpat Kong Astig
programme.desc: At a relatively young age, Joe Cuartero (JinggoyEstrada) is already a widower. With his wife gone, Joe’s life is now centered on his young daughter Tweety (Bea Bueno).

programme.title: Abay Babes
programme.desc: It tells the story of five girls who have been best friends since high school and are reunited for a wedding of the least attractive person in their group.

programme.title: Yorme: The Isko Domagoso Story
programme.desc: Isko Moreno, a once lowly garbage collector who became an actor and now a government servant who dreams for a better life for every Filipino.

programme.title: Reroute
programme.desc: A couple found themselves on a sinister refuge after their car malfunctioned while taking a long-distance route to their hometown.

programme.title: Patayan Files: Ang Pinakamalaking Murder Cases ng Dekada '90
programme.desc: Cheche Lazaro's Probe Archives goes in depth on the controversy behind the gruesome crimes that shocked the entire country during the 90s.

programme.title: Tuloy, Bukas ang Pinto
programme.desc: They are long-lost cousins who grew up in different places and in different ways. When they all finally find themselves gathered at the imposing house of the grandmother, tension builds as they wait for the lawyer who holds their grandmother’s will.

programme.title: Camp Sawi
programme.desc: A group of brokenhearted women end up at a resort that specializes in helping people ease their pain.

programme.title: No Other Woman
programme.desc: The film revolves on a man's journey on becoming a successful working husband whose perfect marriage becomes complicated when he commits into an adulterous affair that changes his life.

programme.title: Petrang Kabayo (2010)
programme.desc: Peter (Vice Ganda) is a boy who is always maltreated by his father because of his homosexuality. He decided to run away and was found by a wealthy lady, Doña Biday, and is adopted by her but becomes abusive of his new found wealth.

programme.title: Milan - Inter
programme.desc: Serie A: Milan - Inter. 23a g. - Entrambe reduci da una vittoria con Parma e Lecce. Il Milan ha vinto entrambi i derby della stagione fra campionato e Supercoppa. Inter a -3 dal Napoli. TC: Compagnoni-Marchegiani.

programme.title: Inter - Genoa
programme.desc: Serie A: Inter - Genoa. 26a g. - Nerazzurri reduci dal ko con la Juve. -2 dal Napoli. Il Genoa arriva dal 2-0 sul Venezia dopo un ko e un pari. A San Siro non vince dal 1994, 3 pari e 17 ko. TC: Marinozzi-Gobbi.

programme.title: Fiorentina - Juventus
programme.desc: Viola con 4 sconfitte in 5 giornate. Juve reduce dal ko contro l’Atalanta (0-4). Una sola sconfitta nelle ultime 8 sfide al Franchi, 4 vittorie e 3 pareggi. TC: Zancan-Marchegiani.

programme.title: Il cono d'ombra: La storia di Denis...
programme.desc: Vent’anni dopo, la famiglia Bergamini prova a fare riaprire le indagini, e vengono individuati nuovi testimoni, ma la Procura non procede. Nel 2017 però arriva la svolta.

programme.title: Marsiglia - Atletico Madrid. Finale
programme.desc: UEFA Europa League 2017/18: Marsiglia - Atletico Madrid. Finale - A Lione tutto e' pronto per Marsiglia-Atletico. Gli spagnoli vogliono alzare per la terza volta questa Coppa. Per il Marsiglia invece l'ultimo trofeo e' la Champions del 1993. Telecronaca di Marianella-Ambrosini.

programme.title: Colpi da maestro
programme.desc: Colpi da maestro.

programme.title: Roma - Barcellona 10/04/18
programme.desc: UEFA Champions League Story: Roma - Barcellona 10/04/18. Quarti Ritorno - Riviviamo i momenti piu' esaltanti di questa competizione attraverso le partite piu' interessanti. Buon divertimento!

programme.title: Parte 2
programme.desc: Milan 1994: piu' che una squadra. Parte 2 - Dalla discesa in campo di Silvio Berlusconi al successo del Milan in Champions League, il racconto di una stagione memorabile attraverso le voci dei protagonisti e un ospite speciale.

programme.title: Desailly e Ramos
programme.desc: In questa puntata diamo uno sguardo a due dei piu' grandi giocatori che hanno vinto la UEFA Champions League: Marcel Desailly e Sergio Ramos.

programme.title: UEFA Champions League: storia di un sogno
programme.desc: Storia della Champions League a partire dalla prima edizione del 1992. Il trofeo, le squadre vincenti e i gol piu' belli.

programme.title: Aston Villa - Paris
programme.desc: Entrambe per la seconda semifinale europea consecutiva. Aston Villa dopo quella di Conference. PSG dopo quella di Champions League. Ha vinto 3-1 all’andata. TC: Borghi-Montolivo.

programme.title: La magia di Bergkamp
programme.desc: In 30 anni di Premier League ci sono stati tanti gol meravigliosi. Ma solo uno e' poesia in movimento: quello di Dennis Bergkamp al Newcastle.

programme.title: Arsenal - PSG
programme.desc: Gunners a una semifinale europea dopo 3 stagioni. PSG alla seconda semifinale di fila in Champions. Non ha mai battuto l'Arsenal nei 3 precedenti. TC: Marianella-Marchegiani.

programme.title: La Stella Rossa
programme.desc: Dall'alba della prima manifestazione a Belgrado contro Milosevic, al tramonto della Jugoslavia del calcio: il trionfo della Stella Rossa a Bari.
